note: What was taken from GetLayers for the UI revamp (feature I16, decision D44). GetLayers is a library for immersive marketing sites; this is an app, so one Style was committed for its surface and motion rules and nothing was materialized as a scene, section or video.

style.title: Relay
kept: glass (backdrop blur) only on what floats over the page: menus and the toast
ink as one colour at three strengths; structure drawn with hairlines at about a tenth
pill-shaped toolbar controls and rounded plates
motion tokens: 150 ms and 250 ms on cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), for colour, opacity and small moves only
Inter for everything the interface says
one serif moment: here it is the coach's voice (Newsreader), not a single word in a headline
changed: the lime accent: it would clash with the green 'best move' label and the board's own colours; blue (#0071e3) is the one 'press here' colour instead
pure black ground: Relay is black so a particle stream reads through its glass; there is no stream here, so the ground is graphite (#161618) and the panes are opaque
Fragment Mono for numbers: tabular figures of the interface face are used instead
spring and scroll-driven reveals: this is a tool used for hours, so nothing moves unless the owner did something

considered.notUsed: 3D scenes, gradients, video backgrounds and the tool effects (orb, shader backgrounds): a shader running beside Stockfish costs heat on this laptop, and ambient motion next to a board the owner is thinking over is a distraction. Open as TRACKER Q25 if one is wanted on the start screen or the bot lobby.
